'''Laser Company''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Company/Legends|company]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Stealth" /> By [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[unit]] was severely depleted in an [[Kessel encounter|encounter]] on<ref name="Stealth" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], with [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Checkers]] being the only [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] survivor. Although the unit was replenished with new [[Troop/Legends|troops]], Checkers chose to be transferred to [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] to serve under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]].<ref name="Stealth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laser Company was mentioned in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Stealth" />
